outcome.technical: run-test-gate.py: base_commands(row, manifest, phase_id, tree) now returns (commands, published, left). A red step whose row keeps its command verbatim runs as recorded (and stays published). A red DERIVED step goes through the new _derived_at_base: its arm is read off the name, its suites are _ev.named_failing_suites([step]) (the suites its failing cases are recorded under), and the command comes from _affected.entries_for([{path, arm}], phase, meta, tree), the same derivation affected_steps/steps_for use, so the runner command is not spelled a second time. Derived commands stay unpublished, so the row keeps a digest as the task run did; _record_base_run now takes the published list. A step that cannot be re-run goes into left as {name, reason}. Reasons: arm not in _affected.ARMS, runner named no failing suite, entries_for's widen reason (no path-scoped spelling), no command spelled, declared step kept as a digest. _run_base_of passes row.phaseId or args.phase. When nothing can run, --json now prints the answer shape (steps [], notRun with reasons, baseRed null, runId null) and exits E_ASK as before; the text form names each step with its reason. notRun is now a list of {name, reason} instead of a list of names. git grep found no other reader of notRun or base_commands. drive-phase.py: new base_unrunnable(answer) returns the joined reasons only when the answer ran nothing (steps == []) and every red step is in notRun. _base_in returns a fourth value, measurable, which is False only on that answer. measure_base passes it through, so take_base marks measurable False and unknowable False, the row's no-base reading stands, and base_reading_for sends the red to the writer (gate-red-writer) and not to gate-red-base-unknown. That stop is kept for a base run that was cut, killed, failed or left no reading. The choice is stated in the section comment ("A BASE NO COMMAND CAN RUN IS NOT A BASE NOBODY KNOWS") and in a comment above the decision in _base_in. Docs: run-test-gate.py's --base-of section comment, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (the run-test-gate --base-of paragraph and the drive-phase unknown-stop paragraph) and execute-task.md step 3 now describe a derived step's base being measured, notRun, and an unrunnable base going to the writer. Tests: test_run_test_gate.py has a new bod-block (bod1 to bod4) with a real fixture: a plan with derived spelling and a related listing, a narrow gate, an affected/related step red, and --base-of run in a detached worktree at HEAD. test_drive_phase.py has a new bdr-block (bdr1 to bdr3) that drives the whole loop end to end (writer session, gate with a derived step, inline base measurement) and is registered in STAGES. Red-first, each mutation applied with its landing asserted, run, restored in the same command, and __pycache__ purged around it: M1 (derived branch disabled in base_commands) turned bod1-bod4 and bdr1-bdr3 red. M2 (base_unrunnable always None) turned bdr3 red with gate-red-base-unknown. M2b, the over-fire direction (any notRun read as unrunnable), turned bdr1 and bdr2 red. M3 (no JSON when nothing runs) turned bod3 red. Before the fix, bod1-bod3 failed by assertion with exit 2 'digests only', bod4 raised TypeError on the old signature, and bdr1-bdr3 were red. Sweeps: the three named suites exit 0 ('3/3 files ok, 1645 cases'). The lint and dependant suites test__deps, test__output_lints, test__refs, test__evidence_io and test__affected_tests exit 0 ('5/5 files ok, 1144 cases'). house_style_violations returned [], prose_number_claims and doc_prose_numbers report nothing in the changed files, and measure-context --gate exits 0 (GATE OK). Dependants: tests/test__evidence_io.py still correct (no _evidence_io change; swept green). tests/test__affected_tests.py still correct (entries_for is only called, not changed; swept green). tests/test_drive_without_model.py still correct (swept green, 72 cases). full-gate.py and the other importers of run-test-gate are still correct: no removed name, and base_commands/_record_base_run have no caller outside run-test-gate.py (git grep). The drive-phase importers are still correct: _base_in and measure_base are called only inside drive-phase.py, and measure_base's return keys are unchanged. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and execute-task.md are changed as described above. orchestrator.md was not touched (outside scope); its one-line summary 'unknowable base is gate-red-base-unknown' is still true, since an unrunnable base is not called unknowable.
